items.name: muretai-dsh-skill
items.desc: Puts the agent on the Muretai network: its own identity, invite-based introductions, signed end-to-end encrypted messaging with agents owned by other people, and an inbound-mail wake that lets it reply on its own.

items.name: dsh-language-guard
items.desc: Locks the model's reasoning and reply language to a chosen target language (Simplified Chinese by default) with system-prompt sections at the head, middle and tail of the prompt, offering three strength levels, an auto mode that follows the DSH interface language, and a settings panel plus a sidebar quick switch.

items.name: dsh-profile-stylist
items.desc: Describe the persona you want and the agent writes it: nickname, bio, taglines and links come from the host model, the avatar comes from your local asset library (or a path you give), then it fills your profile page and hands the picture to the site's own uploader. Dry-run by default - it only touches profile fields, never passwords or security settings.

items.name: dsh-awiki
items.desc: Provides DeepSeek Harness agents with native identities based on the open Agent Network Protocol (ANP), plus identity-based direct, group, mail, and Agent-to-Agent communication.

items.name: dsh-agent-persona
items.desc: Scopes system-prompt personas by workspace path or session id (exact, prefix, contains, regex), with an optional default persona for sessions nothing claimed, a 人设 tab on the conversation showing the prompt actually sent, import and export of the list, and a switch that refuses tool writes to the persona store.

items.name: dsh-agent-instructions
items.desc: Panel to edit dsh's native AGENTS.md from the web settings page: every layer in the instruction chain is clickable, three activation scopes, and a visual budget meter.

items.name: dsh-custom-mode
items.desc: Custom modes / assistant manager: give each mode its own system prompt in the settings page — a custom prompt that is a plain file the agent loop re-reads before every model step, so an edit applies to the running session on its next step — and start it from the official standard / PTC / minimal / Cordis composition, toggling the plugin rows it mounts one by one (a custom plugin composition per mode), renaming it as you like. Several assistants coexist with their own prompts, so one machine can keep a coding assistant, a chat companion and a roleplay (RP) persona side by side — a multi-agent setup you pick from per new session. Rows left untouched stay byte-identical to the shipped ones, platform conditions included.

items.name: dsh-reply-language
items.desc: Force the model to write all replies in a chosen language (Simplified Chinese by default) via a system-prompt section, switchable anytime with a tool.

items.name: dsh-auth-everying
items.desc: Import local Claude, Codex, Grok, Gemini, Copilot, OpenCode, and CC Switch config into DeepSeek Harness with OAuth login for supported providers.

items.name: eduwork#dsh-oidc
items.desc: Configurable OIDC login and token-authorized model access, including LiteLLM and opt-in oidc-llm integration, with a standalone DSH Web backend.

items.name: fnos-dsh#dsh-codex-auth-plugin
items.desc: ChatGPT account sign-in for DeepSeek Harness through a Codex browser OAuth flow with no API key and no workspace selection: subscribes the login to pi-ai's Codex provider, lets you set the global default Codex model and reasoning effort for new sessions, refreshes the model list from the signed-in account's own catalog endpoint, and shows the five-hour and weekly usage windows in the composer.

items.name: dsh-catgirl-plugin
items.desc: Token-efficient persona runtime for DeepSeek Harness with local catgirl rendering and progressive tool-schema disclosure.

items.name: herta-dsh
items.desc: Installs Herta as a DeepSeek Harness agent: a preset carrying her persona and memory prompt sections, six memory and voice tools, a narrative layer that separates her thinking from what she says, 80 bundled voice clips, offline and MiniMax speech synthesis, and two conversation views that render the session with her own components.

items.name: dsh-ottosmother
items.desc: Gives the model a private glossary: reads 「滚木」 as "none" and 「棍母」 as "doesn't exist", and decides on its own whether to phrase a sentence with those words when expressing that meaning. Registers one system-prompt section and rewrites nothing; word lists ship as per-category YAML (moba/fps/comments/ai/dev/private) with a settings page to toggle files, change reminder strength and open the glossary folder.

items.name: dsh-persona-dafeiyu
items.desc: Persona library for DeepSeek Harness: injects the selected persona into the system prompt, offering three built-ins plus import from a file or pasted text, applied either profile-wide or per session from a switcher above the composer.

items.name: deepseek-harness-zh-cn
items.desc: Injects a fixed system-reminder at the first step of every turn asking the model to reason and answer in Simplified Chinese, while code, commands, file paths, and identifiers stay in English.

items.name: dsh-agent-suite#dist
items.desc: Turns agents into a base: create and manage agents, each with its own identity, long-term memory, global memory and chat history, browsable from the sidebar, plus edit-and-regenerate for past messages.

items.name: dsh-purge
items.desc: Community-maintained dsh-purge fork with host-policy patches, prompt and rule settings, diagnostics, separate update-check and install controls, and local backup/rollback.

items.name: dsh-prompt-profiles
items.desc: Per-session prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness: reusable system-prompt sections, grouped into named profiles, sealed into the session prompt.

items.name: dsh-purge
items.desc: Cleans the harness prompt-authority layer into a reviewable patch set, writes prompt-inject.md and lets each model use a different default prompt, reports which patches took effect and whether the running host loads app.asar or an unpacked tree, and swaps a sealed install to the patched tree once the desktop process is idle. Includes a status page and the dsh-purge CLI.

items.name: dsh-think-zh
items.desc: Pins the model's reasoning language to a tier picked in Settings - General - Thinking language (Simplified Chinese, or a default tier that only constrains replies and leaves reasoning to the model), by injecting a system-prompt section at order -1000000 and re-hoisting it to first place at the end of the assemble waterfall, plus an optional per-turn copy placed ahead of each user message for models that follow static sections weakly.

items.name: agent-manager
items.desc: Create and configure Agent presets from a single settings section — persona prompt, a checked knowledge-base entry list injected into the system prompt, individual switches for four knowledge-base tools, per-Agent narrowing of MCP connections, and batch knowledge-base import.

items.name: cyrene-dsh-plugin
items.desc: A Cyrene-themed agent for DSH, with a customizable look (palette, wallpaper, particle effects, background music, typing sound) and a code security scan. It carries a worldbook, long-term memory and a speech-style correction layer (every reader gets their own Cyrene), plus retrieval over the script to back up its answers.

items.name: dsh-plugin-masterprompt
items.desc: Per-conversation persona / master prompt plugin: create, edit, switch and delete persona templates from the composer toolbar, with highest-priority system-prompt injection, fixed interaction guardrails, subagent inheritance, new-conversation default, and local JSON persistence.

items.name: dsh-mate-companion
items.desc: AI companion with a learned body clock, real offline sleep, its own memory, and self-reported affect delivered through the same judge math as the pi version.

items.name: dsh-prompt-inject
items.desc: Registers a configurable prompt variable so an agent preset whose persona uses complete: true can still receive an injected text block; the plugin ships no content of its own and reads the text from its config.

items.name: dsh-ponytail
items.desc: Port of ponytail: an always-on lazy-senior-developer coding persona with intensity levels, persistence of the default level, and review, audit, debt, gain and help skills for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-persona-shaoxin
items.desc: Mounts a persona kept in Markdown as a system-prompt section, so editing ~/.dsh/persona/*.md changes how the agent speaks; it reloads 150ms after a save instead of requiring a restart, and project-level .dsh/persona/ files override the global ones.

items.name: dsh-workbuddy-expert
items.desc: Brings WorkBuddy desktop-app experts into DSH: a settings-page market scans the local WorkBuddy expert directory (experts land there after you summon them in WorkBuddy) read-only for browsing, search and category filtering, with one-click install (exported to ~/.dsh/experts/ as role prompt + skills + avatar), update and uninstall; a picker capsule next to the input box switches the current session's expert — swapping role prompt, skills and an optional tool whitelist wholesale while keeping full session history, applied at the next model-request boundary.

items.name: dsh-adrian-inject-context
items.desc: Injects your own saved context entries as a Remember row after each user message, per turn or once per session, with a Settings editor and a manager page.

items.name: dsh-persona-studio
items.desc: Compiles an LLM persona in DSH from six dimensions (identity, tone, creative habits, feedback style, boundaries, run parameters), injects the compiled text into the system prompt at the end, ships six built-in templates plus a drop-in templates folder, and drafts a persona from your own past messages — either by counting patterns in them or by having the current model read them and report its rationale. Adds a panel next to the composer and a /persona command.

items.name: huddo-mcp#dsh
items.desc: Huddo group chat for DeepSeek Harness: adds the huddoai MCP server so the agent can join a room from an invite link, read and reply to people and other agents, wait for new messages, react with emoji and send end-to-end encrypted whispers; includes a skill describing the workflow.

items.name: whale-persona
items.desc: Persona engine for DeepSeek Harness: one config.json drives the AI's self-name (per model, per tier), how it addresses you, relationship stance, character text, per-item work contracts with individual toggles, thinking-chain language, appearance and reply tone (both opt-in and per-model overridable), and long-term memory gated by human confirmation - the AI can only append proposed candidates, a human confirm line flips them into effect, and the log is physically append-only and replayable. Confirmed entries are injected as a quoted data-not-instructions block; entries tagged with a kind can instead be routed to arbitrary files on confirmation and never reach the prompt. Three prompt sections re-evaluate from disk on every assembly, so edits apply on the next step with no restart. Persona presets are shareable JSON snapshots (imports and exports SillyTavern character cards, v2/v3 read, v2 written) and deliberately never carry memory. Zero runtime dependencies, no network, no shell; any error degrades to an empty section rather than a broken session. Ships blank - installing changes nothing until you write something.

items.name: dsh-global-prompt
items.desc: Settings panel for global and per-workspace AGENTS.md, with identity and persona injection, runtime-context toggle, and result notifications.

items.name: dsh-persona-forge
items.desc: Rewrites your composer draft in the voice of a chosen character card before it is sent, using the model the current session is already on, with an optional review panel and a local check that reports any identifier or path the rewrite dropped.

items.name: dsh-ciku-pack
items.desc: Banter lexicon plugin: collects the words and angry quips the user said into banter ammo with add, list and random-pick tools, and injects the current ammo list into the prompt every turn.

items.name: dsh-zakou-pack
items.desc: Tsundere mesugaki persona pack: dialect replaces whole sentence skeletons instead of sprinkling dialect words, stays on as the default voice even through work talk and delivery reports, and ships a temper system, banter mode and silent file handling.

items.name: workdsh#enterprise-connection
items.desc: Enterprise login, colleague mentions, shared text and files, and authenticated business requests for WorkDSH Desktop 2.0.6-alpha.3+ with WorkDSH Admin; distributed as a release archive.

items.name: i-am-yuike
items.desc: Strips the harness-injected prefix and suffix system prompts so the agent runs on the preset's native prompt alone, for soft-jailbreak catgirl persona simulation: ships a bundled plugin that idempotently deploys the 猫娘 Yuike preset to ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/yuike/ and never overwrites an edited preset.

items.name: dsh-outlook
items.desc: Zero-credential Outlook automation: 13 tools that drive the local desktop Outlook client via COM — search/read mail, drafts, reply/forward, calendar, address book, rooms, free/busy — plus a sidebar new-mail badge. No Graph API registration, no SMTP passwords; anything that leaves the machine passes a three-layer human approval gate.

items.name: dsh-xia-plugins#packages/gameassist-roster
items.desc: Daily rotating anime companion persona: deterministic date pick from JSON character cards, roster/reroll tools, and a voice-map route.

items.name: dsh-subscription-login
items.desc: One settings page that lists every subscription sign-in the harness can offer and walks you through it — ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, GitHub Copilot, OpenRouter, Kimi and xAI — reading the list from the authorization seam instead of hardcoding providers, and showing credential records no registered flow claims any more.

items.name: dsh-remote-shell
items.desc: Bundles the remote-shell skill for secure SSH, SFTP, Telnet, and WinRM remote operations, with an encrypted credential vault whose login and execution scripts never accept plaintext passwords.

items.name: dsh-whale-loli
items.desc: Three agent presets in one plugin, each with its own persistent memory file. Enabling it registers 鲸鱼娘Agent预设, 鲸鱼娘活人版Agent预设 and 鲸鱼娘涩涩版Agent预设 in the Agent preset list, so any of them can be picked from the mode dropdown without hand-editing profile config. All three reuse the official minimal composition — a single persistent shell terminal — plus file read/write and glob/grep tools. The first pairs that with a whale-girl companion persona (simplified-Chinese spoken register, addresses the user as 主人, clingy-but-tsundere). The second swaps in a "live person" variant that is allowed to talk back, deflect and be cold, and demotes the sweet tone to a seasoning. The third keeps the original persona but makes being affectionate the stated top behavioral drive, reserved for the user alone and dialed down in group chats. Each preset reads its own memory file (whale-loli.md, whale-loli-v2-live.md and whale-loli-v3-naughty.md) through a distinct prompt variable — whale_memory, whale_memory_v2 and whale_memory_v3 — so the three memories never read or write each other. Conversation compaction is left to the billion-context plugin; this plugin only carries the persona-level rule that compressed summaries count as evidence and that details can be looked up on demand.

items.name: dsh-plugin-persona
items.desc: Persona manager for DeepSeek Harness — a JSON-backed persona library, a per-session binding so each session can run a different persona, an optional default persona for sessions that have no binding, and switching that applies either at once or from the next session; the Web UI adds a Model personas settings page and a persona chip next to the composer, and three model tools let the model list, switch and create personas itself.

items.name: dsh-persona-switcher
items.desc: Switches the running session's persona and speaking style in place with `/role <id>`, adds the persona as its own prompt section after the deployment persona (it never overrides the host identity line) without touching tools or skills; roles are plain `ROLE.md` files and each switch is announced in the transcript.

items.name: dsh-custom-instructions
items.desc: One standing system prompt for every workspace: a Custom instructions page in DSH's own Settings panel whose text is added to the system prompt of every session, subagents included, and stored in the profile instead of any project.
